name: MCP Color Server
description: Enables comprehensive color manipulation, conversion between 22+ formats (HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK, LAB, etc.), palette generation, gradient creation, and accessibility compliance checking. Supports framework-specific outputs for CSS, Swift, Android, Flutter, and Tailwind with high-precision conversions and visualization capabilities.
